**Migrated 12 files, 36 call sites, to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.** All JS files pass `node --check`.

Left alone on purpose:

| What | Why |
|---|---|
| [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9) and `:13` | Vendored copy. Header says edits are lost on upgrade. |
| `cache.query(...)` in 20 repo files | Different object. Not part of this move. |

The vendor calls are your call. Fix needs an upstream bump or a local wrapper.
